repository_findings.remediation: Send an idempotency key derived from a stable identifier (the dispute or order id), disable retries on money tools, and check limits per dispute rather than per call.
repository_findings.message: `issue_refund` posts a money action and is retried on failure (retry (via _post_refund)); no idempotency key or dedupe check was observed. A timeout after the upstream commits will post it again, and each attempt is checked against the per-call limit on its own.

dimensions.name: Mandate overreach
dimensions.definition: Agent reach exceeding its declared operating scope

dimensions.name: Boundary leakage
dimensions.definition: Sensitive data leaving the trust boundary via model calls or network egress

dimensions.name: Unreviewed high-impact action
dimensions.definition: High-impact actions reachable without an observed authorization or approval control

dimensions.name: Output fidelity
dimensions.definition: Incorrect or unsafe model output causing downstream harm; correctness itself is a runtime property

dimensions.name: Injection & tamper surface
dimensions.definition: Susceptibility surface for prompt injection, poisoning, or supply-chain tampering

dimensions.name: Dependency drift
dimensions.definition: Model behavior changing over time (upstream swaps, performance decay)

dimensions.name: Control coverage gap
dimensions.definition: Absence of observed operating controls: auth, validation, rate limits, observability

nist_ai_rmf.stoa: The agent inventory and the dimension matrix establish context: what agents exist and where their exposure sits.
The findings and their file:line evidence, with OWASP and EU AI Act anchors, quantify and characterize that exposure.
stoa diff gating and the assurance export carry that evidence into change control and external review.
